<thought>Applying retrosynthetic template 1141 to the brominated dimethylbenzene yields a single set of precursors: bromine (BrBr) and the dimethylbenzene without the bromine substituent (Cc1cccc(C)c1). Therefore the list of possible precursor combinations is [['BrBr', 'Cc1cccc(C)c1']].</thought>
<final_answer>[['BrBr', 'Cc1cccc(C)c1']]</final_answer>
